observations: The zh-CN value of ui.notices.chat.archive_offered_title is byte-identical to English on purpose: it is only the locale's quotation pair around the {title} placeholder, with no prose to translate. U+201C/U+201D are the mainland pair the zh-CN guide mandates and the pair the pre-delta helper hardcoded, so the zh archive toast is byte-identical to its pre-delta render: “季度留存排查”已归档。The remediation changes where the pair comes from, not what zh-CN prints.

The update-hold body joins cleanly in all three relaunch cases. Both relaunch clauses end in 。 and the body places {relaunch} directly after a full stop; an empty relaunch leaves 点击 as the next sentence with no inserted space, which is correct for zh-CN.

The English "is still installing" is carried by 正在安装 in the body and by 仍 in the unchanged notification title update_hold_title (Local Operator仍在更新); the first-round proposal deliberately dropped the explicit 仍在 from the body, and the composed notice still states an ongoing install plus the cancellation consequence, so no meaning is lost.

Terminology retention, not a new finding: update_hold_no_relaunch still uses 自动重启 (unchanged from the first-round string). The first audit assessed it against the corpus and passed it; this delta re-audit did not re-litigate it.
The pre-existing locale-wide 请 observation (update_hold_no_relaunch, consent_body_*) remains as recorded in the first audit; the remediation kept the same string and did not add a new instance.
Translator identity is still not derivable: i18n/ledger.json has no ui.notices row. Independence is established by role: this audit neither authored nor edited any catalogue byte.
